project_summary: Telemedicine platform with video consultations and electronic health records integration

components.name: Video consultations
components.description: Browser and mobile video calls between doctor and patient using WebRTC, waiting room, screen sharing and recording with patient consent.

components.name: Patient authentication with OpenID Connect
components.description: Patient and practitioner login through OpenID Connect with two-factor authentication, short-lived access tokens and role-based access to clinical data.

components.name: Appointment scheduling
components.description: Practitioner availability calendars, online booking, cancellation rules and email reminders.

components.name: HL7 FHIR integration
components.description: Read and write of patient summaries, encounters and prescriptions to the hospital electronic health record through an HL7 FHIR R4 API.
